name: How long does an accessible closet modification project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessible closet modification project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an accessible closet modification project depends on its complexity and the extent of the changes. Simple modifications, such as adjusting existing shelving or installing new rods, might be completed within a day or two. More involved projects, like custom built-ins, reconfiguring the internal structure, or widening doorways, could take several days to a week or more. The contractor will provide a more accurate timeline after the initial assessment and design finalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies. Simple modifications can take a day or two, while complex projects with custom built-ins or structural changes may take a week or more.
